newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Stockpile set to decide tin sale.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Stockpile set to decide tin sale.

text.p: Staff members of U.S. Defense National Stockpile Center were due to meet Thursday to make recommendations on a sale of 5,000 tonnes of surplus tin that was offered for sale last month, a Stockpile spokesman said.
The meeting was set for 1100 EDT/1500 GMT, he said.

Stockpile Administrator Richard Connelly will decide which firms to award contracts to based on the recommendations of the staff. An announcement would likely be made later today or Friday, the spokesman said.
The Stockpile offered the tin for sale in long-term contracts Sept 9.
